Let's check if sites themselves can be shared between companies (unlike charging pads), or what happens when a drone isn't at the site where a job starts!
Earlier they said: "I do want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts."
Let's ask about getting a drone to where a job starts (repositioning / ferrying / charging along the way) and where drones end up after a flight!What happens when none of the right drones are currently at the site where a job starts, or after a job finishes away from a drone's home site?
